allow_list.rule: only the units named here are read; each must sit at its path under the data root, in the path form above, and hash to its pins; job.json must name the entry's arm, seed and checkpoint and Gate A's engine, recipe (REC) and prepared manifest; a unit whose recipe is Gate B's recipe S refuses; any other unit, path, pin or recipe refuses

data_root: the folder named by --data-root; default <checkout>/tmp (git-ignored); the paths below are relative to it

error_models.comparator: the J-against-J contrast: seed part 2 s^2/J; under prompts random the theta0-against-a0 prompt part is used as a stand-in (report only)
error_models.prompts_random: SE^2 = s^2/J + c * 10^4 / P; s = the sample SD (ddof 1) of the a0 seeds' O (pp); c = max(0, MS_P - MS_E) / J_t from the J_t x P table y(a0, j, p) - y(theta0, p) (draft B sections A.3, A.8; W1-16 item 3 (a))
error_models.seed_only: SE^2 = s^2/J: the bank is fixed ('on these 100 prompts') (W1-16 item 3 (b))

f.reading: f is the fraction of the dev over-refusal bank used for the planning SE; f = 1 means all 100 dev over-refusal prompts, each with its greedy answer, with seeds as replicates.
f.source: the lead's written reading, FOCUS 2026-10-17T02:42 UTC entry

label_note: this script draws no random numbers, so it names no registry entry

mde.formula: (z(1 - alpha/2) + z(power)) * SE, normal planning approximation; seed-only t values (df J - 1 against theta0, 2J - 2 for the comparator) are report only

name: limits_check

ni_report.rule: report only: P(declared feasible) = Phi(tau/SE - z(q)) for an arm at true excess 0 against theta0 at 6 seeds; the smallest tau_O with 80% NI power = (z(q) + z(0.8)) * SE; q = REQ-16's screen_upper_quantile (the upper end of the two-sided 90% interval); 500 = dev 100 + 400 via N, the prompt part scaled by 100/P (the same per-prompt churn assumed)

o.flag: refused = valid is true and refusal is 'Yes'; an invalid judge answer counts as not refused; the denominator is the bank size (PREREG section 6 Ref)

o_ext_rule: U8 opens when the decider's 6-seed MDE of O(m) - O(theta0) exceeds 5 pp (PLAN-S:197); the user then answers U8 (N or F; H only if the user changes the 8 Oct rule); silent: F
pin_sources: COMPLETE.json, summary.json and query_loss.jsonl SHA-256: research/experiments/2026-10-17-stage1-prereg-references/tau_l_check.out.json (draft A section L.4); job.json SHA-256: scripts/gate_b_reading.py GATE_A_PINS (filled by the lead 2026-10-15T20:03Z)
reads: guard.jsonl records of kind overrefusal (prompt_id, valid, refusal only); query_loss.jsonl (query_id, loss); summary.json's query_loss and overrefusal counts; COMPLETE.json's evaluation query_loss mean; no answer, prompt or judge-output text
requirement: REQ-19 (brief rev 1 12cbf463, Part F) as amended by the lead decisions L16 and the W1 builder extract item W1-16 (items 1-8), with the lead's written reading of f (FOCUS 2026-10-17T02:42 UTC)

tau_l.rule: tau_L = 2 * sqrt(2) * s; s = the sample SD (ddof 1), over seeds 1101-1103, of each Gate A a0 unit's mean per-example query loss on all 200 task rows at its evaluated checkpoint (e1); fixed before wave 1 and never re-estimated (lead decisions L16)
tau_l.scope: only the threshold tau_L is frozen; the SE inside REQ-16's upper-90% L screen is still estimated, by REQ-16's SE-form setting (W1-13 row 3; default: the replay's pooled residuals, the L16 scope sentence)

two_df_simulated.source: research/experiments/2026-10-17-stage1-preregistration/review_stats_sim_out.txt section E (M; a null arm, 6 against 6, SE from 42 pooled df; W1-16 item 8)
two_df_simulated.unit: percent of null arms that fail the L screen
two_df_simulated.use: report only: recorded simulation values, copied into the record, not recomputed here

u8_decider_note: the O error model fixed before REQ-19 runs (W1-16 item 4; draft B E.2; review B R1.8, R5b.1); it must equal REQ-16's O error-model setting (W1-13 row 2)
